calculation.description: Where today's close sits inside the trailing 120-day high-low range, normalized to [0,1]. Captures the slow (multi-month) trend regime of each asset. Positive cross-sectional predictive power at 10-20d horizon (continuation of long trend regime); exhibits meaningful overlap with long-horizon raw momentum (mom_120d_skip5) as expected, but construction is range-based rather than return-based.

validation.regime_notes: Validated 2020-01-01..2026-07-15 on the 15-asset cross-asset universe across regimes: COVID crash 2020, recovery bull 2020-21, 2022 tightening bear, 2023-24 AI-led equity rally, 2024-26 crypto/commodity cycles. Daily cross-sectional Spearman IC, min 8 valid instruments per date. Decay monotone: 1d -0.000, 5d 0.021, 10d 0.038, 20d 0.051.

signal_provenance.source: recomputed from alphacrafter.sim.utils get_stock_daily_data daily OHLC series
signal_provenance.ic_method: daily cross-sectional Spearman rank IC vs 10d forward return
signal_provenance.note: expression is deterministic and fully reproducible from OHLC series only
